fullText:
Good morning. Here is your daily brief for Tuesday 2 June 2026.

🇬🇧 UK politics
- Health Secretary Wes Streeting resigned from Cabinet on 14 May saying he had lost confidence in Starmer's leadership.
- Reform took Havering, its first London local authority, plus Essex county council and Sunderland.
- Labour lost control of Lambeth and Lewisham councils in London to the Green Party.

📱 Gadgets and tech
- Google partnered with Warby Parker to launch Intelligent Eyewear running Android XR with Gemini integration, available as sunglasses and prescription glasses with built-in speakers and cameras.
- Sennheiser Momentum 5 wireless headphones support higher-resolution audio, Dolby Atmos with head-tracking, and now feature user-replaceable batteries to extend lifespan.
- LG C6 OLED TV sets the bar for mid-range OLED TVs in 2026 with industry standout performance and the Insta360 Mic Pro features an industry-first customizable E-ink display for content creators.

Today's question: With Google's new Android XR eyewear and AI integration launching into consumer markets, are you exploring how fractional GTM advisory could position early-stage UK SaaS founders to capitalize on this emerging hardware-software ecosystem before the category saturates?
